title: Place an object
summary: An object's position moves it along three scene axes: x, y and z.
introduction: An object's position moves it along three scene axes: x, y and z. Your task: Move the cube to x=-1.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for place an object

blocks.text: An object's position moves it along three scene axes: x, y and z. The default position is the origin, where all three are zero.

Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Place an object

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: position.set chooses the x, y and z coordinates of the cube relative to its parent.
The camera stays where it was, so the moved cube appears at a new location in that view.

blocks.text: The cube moves right and upward relative to this camera view.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Scene units are not CSS pixels. Their apparent size depends on the camera and distance.
